question: P-0011 and P-0013 were both `tested`, not `verified`: no live journal had ever witnessed the retry, and the refusal they name is thrown while the call is prepared. Which seam carries each, and does naming survive it?

probe.homes: one isolated DSH_HOME per version (.tmp/r56-old, .tmp/r56-new; nothing under ~/.dsh is written)

profiles.refusal: r56-refusal — the real opendesign route, reasoningEffort `xhigh` (the level this model does not map)
profiles.retry: r56-retry — a local OpenAI-compatible endpoint, retryOnMalformed 1
profiles.control: r56-retry-before — the same endpoint and prompt, plugin absent

probe.endpoint: .tmp/r56-fake-openai.mjs — one main-step stream with arguments one `]` short and finish_reason tool_calls (the #12819 shape), then text; the title request gets text

versions.old: the released 0.4.15 dist bytes (.tmp/r56-dist-0415), measured before this tree changed

probe.note: the endpoint is local and synthetic: it reproduces the adapter failure, not a relay incident

control.stderr_first: dsh: MALFORMED_RESPONSE: Tool call "ops_bash": Expected ',' or ']' after array element in JSON at position 61 (line 1 column 62)

old_refusal.stderr_first: dsh: UNSUPPORTED_REASONING_EFFORT: provider "opendesign" model "deepseek-v4.1-flash-eco" does not support reasoning effort "xhigh"

error.message: provider "opendesign" model "deepseek-v4.1-flash-eco" does not support reasoning effort "xhigh"

new_refusal.stderr_first: dsh: UNSUPPORTED_REASONING_EFFORT: provider "opendesign" model "deepseek-v4.1-flash-eco" does not support reasoning effort "xhigh"

error.message: provider "opendesign" model "deepseek-v4.1-flash-eco" does not support reasoning effort "xhigh"

findings: The retry path is real and was already live in the released bytes: the control run made two main-step requests? (see runs.control) and exited 1, while both retry runs made three, wrote exactly one `retry` event and ended `completed` at exit 0.

`agent/request-error` is never dispatched for a refusal thrown during preparation. The released bytes wrote no journal at all for the xhigh run; a probe listener on both candidate seams saw one `agent/error` and zero `agent/request-error`. That is the host split, quoted from `dsh-agent-loop/lib/index.js`: line 942 dispatches `agent/request-error` only after a started stream fails; line 657 emits `agent/error` from the loop catch.

P-0045 names the refusal on `agent/error` and shares one `(turn, step, code)` set with `agent/request-error`, so a failure both seams can see is named once. The new bytes write exactly one `diagnosis` for the same profile and turn that the released bytes wrote zero for.
No request was added by the fix: the refusal run still makes no model call (the code refuses before dispatch), and the retry run still makes exactly three.
not_proven: One provider route and one model. `opendesign/deepseek-v4.1-flash-eco` is the route this machine uses; another adapter may throw the refusal on a different seam.
The endpoint is local and synthetic: it reproduces the adapter's `MALFORMED_RESPONSE`, not a relay incident.
One turn per run, one prompt. A multi-step turn and a tool-call turn were not exercised.
The desktop app was not driven; these are headless CLI runs.

verdict.p0011: verified — the retry decision, its bound and its completion are witnessed by a live journal
verdict.p0013: verified — the diagnosis reaches the journal on the seam the host actually uses
verdict.p0045: the seam split, measured on both the released and the changed bytes
